columns.name: DUNNING_CONF_DETAIL_ID
columns.description: Primary key.

columns.name: TEMPLATE_NAME
columns.description: The template name of the dunning letter.

columns.name: DUNNING_PLAN_ID
columns.description:
Foreign key to IEX_DUNNING_PLANS.
Which dunning plan this detail belongs to.

columns.name: XDO_TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description:
Foreign key to XDO_TEMPLATES.
What letter template is used by this plan detail.

columns.name: AGING_BUCKET_LINE_ID
columns.description:
Foreign key to AR_AGING_BUCKET_LINES
This column is mutually exclusive with column stage_number. Only one will have a value, the other will be null.
This represents what aging bucket this dunning detail is used against. If the oldest invoice of a customer falls in this aging bucket then the dunning letter stored here will be sent.

columns.name: STAGE_NUMBER
columns.description:
Foreign key to AR_AGING_BUCKET_LINES
This column is mutually exclusive with column aging_bucket_line_id. Only one will have a value, the other will be null.
This represents the stage of the customer's delinquencies, a stage is kept for every delinquent payment schedule, if the oldest invoice of a custemer is on the stage then the letter template stored here will be sent to the customer.

columns.name: CALLBACK_FLAG
columns.description:
Valid values are 'Y' and 'N' and null, null means 'N'.
This indicates if a follow up call should be automatically created by the application if the delinquency is not cured after the letter is received.

columns.name: CALLBACK_DAYS
columns.description: Number of days to wait before creating a follow up call for a collector to call a delinquent customer.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SET_ID
columns.description: Identifies a set of reference data shared across business units and other entities. Also known as Reference Data Sets, they are used to filter reference data in transactional UIs.

columns.name: WAIT_DAYS
columns.description: Number of days to wait before the system sends the next set of dunning letters.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.

columns.name: AUDIT_IMPERSONATOR_
columns.description: Original Impersonator User.
